note: Seven fresh reviewers, not shown the old verdicts. `reviewer` is theirs; `disposition` is what was done.

acidArrow.loop: Caustic Arrow: a bow shot that bursts for chaos damage where it lands and leaves caustic ground for 2 s; enemies standing in it take chaos damage over time, overlapping patches do not stack, and the ground comes even if the arrow misses.

anvilDrop.loop: Vengeance: an attack you cannot use directly; when you are hit there is a 30% chance it triggers a swift counter-attack on all enemies around you.

missing: Secondary arc (each chain also forks to a second enemy)
15% more damage per remaining chain (damage ramp along the chain)
arcChain.loop: Arc: a chaining lightning spell with shock; in 3.9 each chain also forks to a second enemy (a branch that cannot chain), and it deals 15% more damage for each remaining chain, so it is strongest at the start of the chain and rewards packs.

disposition.what: Each chain also reaches a second enemy; 15% more damage for each chain still to come.

arcaneWard.loop: Discipline: an aura reserving 35% mana that grants flat additional energy shield (60-217) and 30% increased ES recharge rate.

arrowShower.loop: Rain of Arrows: a bow attack that fires a salvo into the air; arrows land after a delay starting at the target spot and spreading outward, each dealing area damage; wide ground-clearing, cheap, cannot pierce or chain.

missing: Monster's own skills/abilities and damage type are lost (every spectre hits as chaos with a generic strike)
No choice of which monster to raise: nearest corpse by policy, so no 'pick the best monster' loop
bindShade.loop: Raise Spectre: raises a defeated monster from a corpse as a minion that keeps the basic abilities/skills it had in life (the whole point is choosing which monster to raise); level set by the gem (31-80), 1-2 spectres.

disposition.why: A spectre keeps only its monster’s damage factor, rate and range, not its abilities; the nearest corpse is raised.

bladeWind.loop: Reckoning: a counter-attack that triggers automatically when you block with a shield, hitting enemies in a cone in front of you; cannot be used directly.

missing: Final wave always ignites
Final wave's 500% more ignite damage (ignite not scaled by release or by stages)
Stage bonus does not apply to ailments
blazeStream.loop: Incinerate: channel a fire cone that grows each 0.2 s tick (25% more hit AND ailment damage per stage, wider/longer, up to 8 stages); on release a huge final wave deals 500% more hit damage and ALWAYS ignites with 500% more ignite damage - the stage-up-then-big-ignite payoff.

disposition.what: The final wave always ignites, for 500% more ignite damage.

blazeTrap.loop: Fire Trap: a trap that explodes on trigger for fire damage and leaves 1.75 s of burning ground damaging enemies who stay in it.

blessedTrail.loop: Consecrated Path: a slam that teleports you to a nearby enemy, deals half-fire damage around the landing point and leaves 4 s of consecrated ground (6% life regen/s, enemies on it take hits with doubled crit chance).

blightColossus.loop: Summon Chaos Golem: a single chaos golem (melee, chaos aura, spikes) that grants the owner 3-4% additional physical damage reduction while it lives.

blightHail.loop: Scourge Arrow: channel a bow attack to build up to 5 stages (150% more damage each); release a piercing arrow that drops a spore pod per stage along its way, each blooming into 9 thorn arrows at 50% less damage.

blinkingCut.loop: Flicker Strike: teleport to a monster and strike; 2 s cooldown that can be bypassed by spending a Frenzy charge; 15% to gain a Frenzy charge on hit, +10% attack speed per charge, and a 3 s movement speed buff on use.

missing: No cooldown (3.9 Vortex has a 1.8 s cooldown, so it is a timed secondary rather than something cast every 0.6 s)
Not a nova around the caster: the zone sits on the target position within 6 tiles, and zones from repeated casts each pulse and stack (3.9 lets only the strongest vortex deal damage)
The big damage-over-time patch is modelled as repeated hits
blizzardRing.loop: Vortex: instant cold nova around the caster that hits and leaves a 3 s chilling vortex dealing cold damage over time and chilling enemies in it (short cooldown).

disposition.what: Blast around the caster that leaves a vortex; cooldown; can expand from Frostbolt projectiles.

bloodSurgeCall.loop: Blood Rage: a buff giving attack speed and life leech while you lose 4% of max life and ES per second as physical damage; kills refresh the duration and can give a Frenzy charge.

boltCleave.loop: Lightning Strike: a melee strike (half converted to lightning) that, when it lands, fires 5-7 lightning projectiles in an ~85 degree arc that hit farther-away enemies for 25% less damage and cannot miss.

boltStep.loop: Lightning Warp: cast to mark a destination, wait the time the run would take (reduced by gem level), then teleport; lightning damage hits around both the place left and the place reached; further casts queue; you can act meanwhile.

boltTrap.loop: Lightning Trap: a trap that fires a ring of 9 lightning projectiles through the enemy that triggered it; 20% shock chance, big crit chance against shocked enemies.

boneWardRite.loop: Bone Offering: consume a corpse (and up to 4 more nearby, +1 s each) to give all minions +25-35% attack block / +25-34% spell block and life recovery on block for 5 s+; only one offering at a time.

brimstoneStorm.loop: Storm Burst: channel to create orbs that jump about the target spot every 0.4 s for 1.2 s, exploding after each jump; on release all remaining orbs explode in a larger area for 75% more damage per remaining jump.

brittleDoom.loop: Elemental Weakness: a curse on all enemies in an area for ~9-11 s lowering their elemental resistances by 20-39%.

bulwarkRush.loop: Shield Charge: a movement attack that charges at the target; damage comes from the shield (not the weapon) and grows the farther you charge (up to 100% more), with greater stun chance at range; pushes enemies aside and hits repeatedly en route plus a bigger hit at the end.

callBonewalkers.loop: Summon Skeletons: summon 2-3 melee skeleton warriors per cast up to 5-8 at once; they last 20 s.

callFuries.loop: Summon Raging Spirit: short-lived (5 s) flaming skulls that rush enemies and attack rapidly; recast to keep them up.

carrionColossus.loop: Summon Carrion Golem: one golem that gives your non-golem minions added physical damage and deals 8% more damage per non-golem minion near it (max 80%), with more life.

chargeRelease.loop: Discharge: consume all charges to nova the area around you with fire per Endurance charge, cold per Frenzy and lightning per Power charge; 35% less damage if triggered.

chargedBlow.loop: Static Strike: a melee strike (60% lightning) whose hit grants a 4 s buff, stacking to 3; while it lasts, beams hit 4-6 nearby enemies every 0.4 s (10% faster per stack), for less damage while still than moving, and chain once.

chillingShard.loop: Freezing Pulse: a short-ranged cold projectile that pierces everything and has a chance to freeze (25% at the origin falling to 0 over the first quarter of its life); damage fades with distance.

cinderBlow.loop: Infernal Blow: a fire-converted strike that puts a charge on the enemy (up to 6, 0.8 s); at 6, on expiry or on death the charges explode in an area for 66% of the hit per charge; enemies carrying it also explode on death for 6% of their life as fire.

cinderBond.loop: Searing Bond: a totem (+1 max) that casts a fire beam at you and at each other totem; enemies in a beam or near either end take burning damage over time (no hit); 8 s totems.

cinderHerald.loop: Herald of Ash: reserves mana; 15% of physical damage gained as fire, more spell fire damage, and when you kill an enemy nearby enemies burn for 25% of the overkill damage per second for 4 s.

cinderStep.loop: Flame Dash: teleport to a location, burning enemies where you land and leaving 4 s of burning ground along the path; short cooldown shared with other blinks.

cleansingBlaze.loop: Purifying Flame: a wave of divine fire in a line, then consecrated ground and a burst around the target, then a larger shockwave hitting enemies on the consecrated ground that were not already hit (25% less damage).

clearMind.loop: Clarity: aura reserving a flat amount of mana (34-279) that grants flat mana regeneration per second.

clusterBolt.loop: Kinetic Blast: a wand shot that explodes at impact in a cluster of 4 small explosions; area-oriented clearing that scales with projectile count.

crackleRing.loop: Lightning Tendrils: channelled; rapid lightning pulses in a semicircle in front of you, every 4th pulse 50% stronger.

creepingPlague.loop: Contagion: a chaos damage-over-time debuff (no hit) on all enemies in an area for 5 s; when an affected enemy dies it spreads to nearby enemies with its remaining duration.

missing: Knockback
20% chance to deal double damage
Extra melee range
Slower attack speed
crushingBlow.loop: Heavy Strike: a slow, hard-hitting melee strike with extra reach that knocks enemies back, reduces enemy stun threshold, and has a 20% chance to deal double damage.

disposition.what: Knockback and a 20% chance to deal double damage.

crushingHalo.loop: Pride: an aura reserving 50% mana; enemies near you take at least 15-19% more physical damage, rising to 30-39% the longer they stay in the aura.

deathlessCall.loop: Immortal Call: a guard for 1 s taking 25-35% less physical and 25-34% less elemental damage; spends up to 5 Endurance charges for +20% duration and 15% less physical damage each; shares a cooldown with other guards, does not recover during the effect.

doomSigil.loop: Armageddon Brand: a brand attached to an enemy that every 0.75 s (scaled by cast speed) calls a fiery meteor on it for area damage with a 25% ignite chance and strongly boosted ignite damage; detaches if the enemy dies; up to 3 brands.

drainTrap.loop: Siphoning Trap: a trap that tethers up to 10 enemies for 3 s with beams that chill and deal cold damage over time; you regenerate life and mana per second, a flat amount while any is tethered plus more per enemy.

missing: No travelling projectile: a stationary zone at the aim point, so no sweep through a pack and projectile supports (slower/more projectiles, pierce) do nothing
About 5 pulses at 0.4 s instead of a hit every 0.15 s
driftingStorm.loop: Ball Lightning: a slow piercing projectile that continuously strikes all enemies around it with lightning bolts as it travels (hit rate limited to every 0.15 s).

disposition.what: A slow orb that strikes everything about it as it drifts.

duneStance.loop: Blood and Sand: a reserved stance toggling Blood (melee skills +10-15% more area damage, 5% less area) and Sand (10-15% more area, 5% less area damage); shared with Flesh and Stone.

emberColossus.loop: Summon Flame Golem: one ranged fire golem that grants you 15-20% increased damage while it lives.

emberDownpour.loop: Blast Rain: a bow attack with 5 arrows landing in overlapping explosions at the target spot, 100% converted to fire with 15-25% fire penetration.

emberHail.loop: Firestorm: flaming bolts rain over a target area for 2 s, one impact every 0.1 s, each exploding for area fire damage.

emberWard.loop: Purity of Fire: aura reserving 35% mana granting 22-41% fire resistance and 0-4% maximum fire resistance.

fatherTotem.loop: Ancestral Protector: a 12 s totem that strikes nearby enemies with your weapon only while you are within ~85 units of it; being near it gives 10-20% more attack speed.

faultline.loop: Earthquake: a slam with an axe/mace/staff that damages an area and cracks the ground; after ~1 s the crack erupts in a larger aftershock with 70% more damage.

feebleGrip.loop: Enfeeble: curses enemies in an area for 9-11 s: 21-30% less damage (about half for rares/uniques), less accuracy, 25% reduced crit chance and lower crit multiplier.

fervorHalo.loop: Zealotry: a reserving aura giving you and allies more spell damage and increased spell crit chance, plus a chance to leave Consecrated Ground when hitting stronger enemies (PoB 3.9 description; wiki unreachable).

fireBreathTrap.loop: Flamethrower Trap: a trap that, when triggered, leaves flamethrowers that keep dealing fire damage for about 3.5 s; enemies already burning take more.

flameBolt.loop: Fireball: a fire projectile that explodes on impact for area damage and can ignite.

fleshSurgeRite.loop: Flesh Offering: consumes a corpse (and nearby ones, each adding duration) to give your minions attack, cast and movement speed for a few seconds; one at a time.

flurryOfEdges.loop: Blade Flurry: channel to strike in an arc repeatedly while damage ramps per stage; on release you unleash an extra hit per stage reached.

frostHalo.loop: Hatred: aura giving physical damage gained as extra cold plus more cold damage.

frostLance.loop: Ice Spear: spears that travel slowly, then change to a fast, piercing second form with a hugely better crit chance and multiplier; fires an extra projectile.

frostQuill.loop: Ice Shot: a bow arrow converting 60% of physical to cold with strong chilling, plus a cone behind the target converting everything to cold.

missing: Cast on Frostbolt (Glacier Dart) projectiles: nova from several projectiles, repeat from the same ones
Chilled bonus is checked on the primary target only, not per enemy hit
frostRing.loop: Ice Nova: a cold nova from the caster, with extra cold damage against chilled enemies; its signature is being cast on Frostbolt projectiles so the nova expands from each of them (PoB 3.9 description).

disposition.what: Can expand from up to two of the character’s Frostbolt projectiles.

frostSunder.loop: Ice Crash: a melee slam, half converted to cold, that damages an area around the impact in three stages (the second and third slightly weaker).

frostTrap.loop: Ice Trap: a trap that, when stepped near, creates icy explosions dealing cold damage to those caught in the blast.

frostWard.loop: Purity of Ice: an aura giving cold resistance and, at higher level, maximum cold resistance.

furnaceRoar.loop: Flameblast: channel to build up to 10 stages of a big fire explosion released when you stop; damage and area grow per stage, ignite chance grows with stages.

fuseArrow.loop: Explosive Arrow: arrows stick in enemies and explode after a short fuse; further arrows stuck in the same enemy join the first explosion, enlarging it and boosting its ignite.

ghostBlades.loop: Ethereal Knives: a wide arc of physical knives (10 projectiles) in front of the caster.

missing: Return leg and repeat hits: the projectile stops at the first enemy (pierce 0)
Spiral path, nothing separates it from Phantom Toss
ghostCoil.loop: Spectral Helix: throws a spectral copy of the weapon that spirals out and back, hitting enemies along its path (no PoB data; judged from the gem's tags Attack/Projectile and Bob's own description).

disposition.what: Pierces, so it hits on both legs.

ghostShard.loop: Spectral Shield Throw: a thrown shield copy that does not pierce, damage from shield defences, shattering into shards that fly in all directions (25% less damage).

glacierDart.loop: Frostbolt: a slow cold projectile that pierces through enemies.

glacierWall.loop: Frost Wall: raises a wall of ice that holds enemies back and damages and pushes those under it; has a short cooldown.

gougeShot.loop: Puncture: a bow/dagger/claw/sword attack that always bleeds, with a long bleed (8 s base) that scales with skill duration and has more bleed damage.

guardedStrike.loop: Vigilant Strike: a powerful melee strike that gives Fortify; 4 s cooldown that can be bypassed by spending an Endurance Charge.

missing: Nova triggered by the player's attack hits, physical, with its own cooldown
Regen granted only by the nova's effect; higher regen for minions
Relic acts as an independent fire shooter instead
hallowedRelic.loop: Summon Holy Relic: a relic stays near you and, when you hit with an attack, triggers a short-cooldown nova of physical damage that grants life regeneration to allies (more to minions).

disposition.what: Answers the character’s attack hits with a nova; mends the character and minions.

missing: Lightning damage type/tag of the original (Bob's version is purely physical)
haloSweep.loop: Holy Sweep: a 360-degree melee sweep around you (the reference lists it as an Attack/AoE/Melee/Lightning skill). No PoB data and the wiki was unreachable, so the original's details are inferred from its tags and from Bob's port note.

disposition.why: The reviewer judged from the later gem’s tags; the 3.9 page is Sweep, which is what it now is.

hoarfrostMote.loop: Winter Orb: channel to hold an orb over you that pelts nearby ground with exploding cold projectiles; stages built while channelling lengthen it and speed it up; stages decay when you stop.

huntSigil.loop: Sniper's Mark: a Mark curse on one enemy that makes your projectile attacks stronger/more accurate against it and makes it take more damage (no PoB data; judged from Bob's description and general knowledge, wiki unreachable).

hurledSteel.loop: Lancing Steel: a sword/axe thrust that hurls a primary impaling projectile plus extra small shards; each enemy can be hit by only one projectile of the skill.

icicleCharge.loop: Icicle Mine: a mine that, when detonated, fires a nova of cold projectiles around it (an extra one per two mines in the sequence).

ironHide.loop: Steelskin: a guard buff that absorbs part of the damage from hits until depleted; shares a cooldown with other guards, which does not recover while the buff lasts.

jawsTrap.loop: Bear Trap: a trap that damages and immobilises an enemy for a time based on the damage dealt, then leaves a decaying slow and makes it take more damage from traps and mines.

judgementTempest.loop: Divine Ire: channel to build stages (faster against crowds/stronger enemies) while zapping nearby enemies for reduced damage; release a beam whose damage grows greatly per stage.

keenHalo.loop: Precision: aura giving accuracy rating and increased critical strike chance.

missing: Fire damage (burst is chaos)
Exerted/empowered melee attacks component suggested by the Attack/Melee/Trigger tags
kindledBellow.loop: Infernal Cry: a warcry (tagged Fire, Attack, Melee, Trigger in the reference) that debuffs nearby enemies, slowing them by an amount tied to how many are near and making those that die while affected burst. No PoB data and the wiki was unreachable; inferred from the reference tags and Bob's own description.

disposition.why: The reviewer judged it from later tags with low confidence; the ledger’s earlier check against the 3.9 page stands.

kindlingHalo.loop: Anger: aura adding fire damage to attacks and spells.

lanceBow.loop: Siege Ballista: summons ballista totems (up to three) that attack with piercing arrows at reduced attack speed.

leadenLimbs.loop: Temporal Chains: a curse on an area that slows enemies (rares and uniques less) and makes effects on them expire more slowly.

lureTotem.loop: Decoy Totem: places a totem for 8 s that taunts nearby monsters into attacking it; 4 s cooldown; deals no damage.

magmaCrack.loop: Tectonic Slam: a fire-converted slam over a wide area that may consume an Endurance Charge to perform a more powerful Charged Slam.

maliceHalo.loop: Malevolence: aura giving more damage over time and increased skill effect duration.

mendingTotem.loop: Rejuvenation Totem: places a totem for about 8 s whose aura regenerates life for you and nearby allies.

mindDrain.loop: Power Siphon: a wand volley of extra projectiles that kills enemies under 10% life and builds Power Charges, whose crit bonuses it uses.

missing: Clone uses the character's bow/quiver (attack scales with the player's gear)
Arrow travel to the target location before the clone appears
mirrorQuiver.loop: Mirror Arrow: fires an arrow that summons a clone for 3 s, with a 3 s cooldown; the clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver, i.e. copies your attacks.

disposition.why: The clone is a generic archer, not a copy that uses the character’s bow and gear.

mortarBow.loop: Artillery Ballista: ballista totems (up to three) that lob volleys of fiery arrows landing in a line, each bursting in an area; attack at half speed.

mortarCharge.loop: Pyroclast Mine: a mine that bursts in fire and rains smaller fiery projectiles around it (more of them later in the sequence); mines near an enemy add fire damage taken.

openWounds.loop: Vulnerability: a curse making enemies take more physical damage and physical damage over time, with a chance for attacks to bleed and maim them.

orbitingBlades.loop: Blade Vortex: each cast adds a blade (up to 10) circling you for 5 s; blades hit everything around every 0.6 s, faster, harder and with better crit per blade.

penance.loop: Punishment: a curse that makes enemies grant a buff of more melee damage and increased attack speed to anyone who hits them in melee (and lowers their physical damage reduction).

missing: Passing through enemies in its path
Return leg / second hit as it comes back (only when it misses everything)
phantomToss.loop: Spectral Throw: throws a spectral copy of the melee weapon that flies out and returns, spinning and damaging enemies in its path.

disposition.what: Pierces, so it hits on both legs.

plentySigil.loop: Poacher's Mark: marks an enemy so it has less evasion; hitting it restores life and mana, killing it gives extra flask charges and a chance of a Frenzy charge.

primalStrike.loop: Elemental Hit: each attack randomly picks fire, cold or lightning (never the same twice in a row), deals only that element, hits an area around the target (larger if it suffers that element's ailment) and deals more damage per elemental ailment.

primeSplash.loop: Wild Strike: a melee strike with all physical converted to a random element, followed by a fire explosion, an arcing lightning bolt or an icy wave.

pyreBurst.loop: Cremation: consume a targeted corpse; it explodes for 4% of its max life and becomes a geyser that sequentially fires projectiles around itself for 8 s; at most 3 geysers at once.

missing: projectiles pierce all targets (3.9 stat text: Projectiles Pierce all Targets)
consecrated ground around the totem (and its curse immunity / ground effects)
pyreTotem.loop: Holy Flame Totem: cheap, fast (0.25 s) totem that streams fire projectiles that pierce all targets at nearby enemies and lays consecrated ground around itself (curse immunity for you and allies).

disposition.what: The projectiles pierce (the consecrated ground of the original is not built).

quakeBlow.loop: Ground Slam: mace/axe/staff slam that makes a wave with a high stun chance (25% reduced enemy stun threshold) and deals up to 40-49% more damage to closer enemies.

quakeTotem.loop: Shockwave Totem: totem that releases physical shockwaves around itself, damaging (and 25% chance to knock back) nearby enemies.

quickStep.loop: Dash: instant short teleport towards a target location, 2 s cooldown (one use), no damage, shares a cooldown with other blink skills.

quickeningHalo.loop: Haste: reserve mana for an aura giving increased attack, cast and movement speed.

quickeningShot.loop: Frenzy: an attack that grants a Frenzy charge on hit and gets 5% more damage and 5% more attack speed per charge held.

quiverRush.loop: Barrage (the 3.9 active skill): after a short preparation, fire 1+4 projectiles in rapid sequence with a ~20 degree random spread, 40-47.6% damage each; because they are sequential every projectile can hit the same enemy.

missing: volleys that widen outwards
6% less damage and 20% less crit chance per volley
per-enemy hit count (about one hit in the original, five identical hits here)
rainOfSteel.loop: Bladefall: ethereal weapons rain in 5 cascading volleys, each wider but 6% less damaging (and 20% less crit chance) than the last; enemies are mostly hit once, more where volleys overlap; +100% crit chance.

disposition.why: The five volleys are identical; the original’s each get wider and weaker.

missing: needs and consumes a corpse for each zombie
separate slam attack with its own cooldown/area scaling (folded into a splash)
raiseHusk.loop: Raise Zombie: consumes a corpse to raise a zombie that follows you and fights with melee and an unevadable AoE slam; up to 3-7 zombies.

disposition.what: Uses up a corpse for each cast.

rallyingRoar.loop: Rallying Cry: warcry (4 s shared warcry cooldown, 8 s duration) giving increased damage that scales with surrounding enemies plus mana regeneration, and taunting nearby enemies.

rampage.loop: Berserk: needs 5 rage to start; spends rage at an accelerating rate (5/s, +20% each second) for more attack damage/speed/movement speed and less damage taken; cooldown does not recover while active.

reapingArc.loop: Cleave: arc melee hitting everything in front; hits with both weapons when dual wielding (each at reduced damage); axes and swords only.

rimeColossus.loop: Summon Ice Golem: one golem (6 s cooldown) that fights for you and grants you 20-30% increased crit chance and accuracy while it stands; uses melee, icy barrage and chilling dash.

rimeCore.loop: Frost Bomb: place a crystal that pulses for 2 s applying a 5 s debuff (-25% cold res exposure, 75% less life/ES regen); then it explodes for heavy cold damage; 2.5 s cooldown; only the explosion is a hit.

missing: extra chance for cursed enemies to be frozen by cold damage (half of the curse's effect)
rimeCurse.loop: Frostbite: curse an area: -25..-44% cold resistance and +10..14% chance to be frozen by cold damage, 9-10.9 s.

disposition.what: Cursed enemies are more likely to be frozen.

missing: projectile with impact burst
chilling ground as a damage-over-time area that creeps toward enemies
several concurrent areas
rimeDrift.loop: Creeping Frost: icy projectile that bursts on impact/at the target area, dealing area damage and leaving chilling ground that deals cold damage over time and creeps across the ground toward nearby enemies for its duration (up to 10 areas).

disposition.why: A stationary zone of repeated hits, not a projectile that leaves a creeping, damaging chilled area.

rimeHerald.loop: Herald of Ice: reserve mana for added cold damage to spells and attacks; enemies killed while frozen (shattered) explode for AoE cold damage.

rimeMallet.loop: Glacial Hammer: mace/sceptre/staff strike converting 60% physical to cold, 25% freeze chance, added cold vs chilled enemies, every third strike freezes as though dealing 200-390% more damage, and frozen enemies under 1/3 life shatter (not uniques).

rimePlate.loop: Arctic Armour: reserve mana; enemies that hit you are chilled for 0.5 s, you leave chilled ground while moving, and you take 8-13% less physical and 8-12% less fire hit damage while stationary.

rimeRebuke.loop: Riposte (3.9 'Glacial Shield Swipe' page): counter-attack triggered when you block, 160-230% base damage, uses both weapons when dual wielding, 0.8 s cooldown, cannot be used directly.

rimeSpires.loop: Glacial Cascade: a line of overlapping icicle bursts (physical 60% converted to cold) that damage enemies caught in them, an enemy sometimes being hit more than once.

rimeSplinter.loop: Frost Blades: melee strike with increased range (60% phys->cold, added cold) that releases icy projectile blades from behind the first enemy struck toward other enemies.

rimeStep.loop: Frostblink: teleport, dealing cold damage and leaving chilled ground where you left; cooldown (shared with blinks) recovers faster per enemy nearby, much faster for rares/uniques.

missing: damage-over-time debuff beams on many enemies (replaced by repeated hits in a circle)
chilling of tethered enemies
rotDrainTrap.loop: Siphoning Trap of Pain (transfigured Siphoning Trap, not in 3.9): trap that tethers beams to the nearest 13-18 enemies for a heavy cold damage-over-time debuff, chilling them; no cooldown, no regeneration.

disposition.why: Not a 3.9 gem (the reference page is later).

rotStride.loop: Withering Step: blink-group movement skill that renews Elusive and grants Phasing; enemies that first come near get 4-6 Withered stacks (3 s); using any skill ends it; cooldown does not run while it lasts.

rotTouch.loop: Wither: channelled; repeatedly hinders enemies in an area (30-36% slower) and applies stacking Withered (+6% chaos damage taken each, up to 15, 2 s).

ruinRitual.loop: Bane: hitless chaos damage-over-time debuff in an area that also applies linked curses, dealing more damage (28-47%) and lasting 50% longer for each curse applied.

ruinSigil.loop: Assassin's Mark: curse in an area; hits against cursed enemies get +1.5-2.5% crit chance and extra crit damage taken; killing them grants 16-25 life and mana and a 21-30% chance of a Power charge.

rumbleTrap.loop: Seismic Trap: trap that, once triggered, releases 5 waves 0.9 s apart, each a line of small bursts ending in a larger one, dealing physical damage.

ruptureLine.loop: Sunder: slam with mace/sceptre/axe/staff sending a wave forward; each enemy it hits releases a circular shockwave hitting others for 60% less damage.

sapBolt.loop: Essence Drain: projectile that explodes on impact, putting a chaos damage-over-time debuff (3.8 s) on enemies in a small radius and regenerating you for 0.05x the debuff's tooltip damage per second per afflicted enemy; spreads with Contagion.

scatterBolt.loop: Kinetic Blast: wand projectile that creates a cluster of 4 small explosions around its impact point (35% less area damage each).

scatterBow.loop: Shrapnel Ballista: ballista totems (+2 max, so 3), 8 s, firing 3 arrows with added physical damage, enemies can be hit by several arrows of one shot.

scorchWave.loop: Flame Surge: narrow fire surge in front of you; 50-88% more damage with hits against burning enemies; cannot ignite.

searingLance.loop: Scorching Ray: channelled beam that deals no hit, builds a fire damage-over-time debuff by stages (up to 8, each adding 60% of the first), applies fire exposure at max stages, and keeps burning 1.5 s after leaving the beam.

searingMantle.loop: Righteous Fire: no reservation; you burn for 90% of max life per second (nonlethal, mitigated by fire resistance) while enemies nearby burn for 20% of your max life per second; large more spell damage; ends at 1 life.

shadowQuiver.loop: Blink Arrow: fire an arrow to a destination; when it lands you teleport there and leave a 3 s clone archer at your old spot; 3 s cooldown, shared with blinks.

shadowSwap.loop: Bodyswap: teleport to a targeted enemy or corpse (corpses preferred), fire damage in an area at both places plus 3% of your max life; at a corpse the area is 300% bigger and the corpse explodes for 6% of its life.

shrapnelTrap.loop: Explosive Trap: trap that makes one large explosion then 4-7 smaller explosions in quick succession (physical 50% converted to fire).

missing: random, ricocheting movement and lingering 2 s lifetime
repeat hits by the same cast over time
skitterFlash.loop: Spark: launches 5-7 unpredictable sparks that move randomly and ricochet off walls for 2 s until they hit an enemy, each cast able to hit an enemy about every 0.66 s.

disposition.what: The sparks wander at random and bounce off walls.

skyfall.loop: Storm Call: set a marker; 1.5 s later lightning strikes it and every other marker you have placed.

missing: damaging hits always stun enemies on full life
always knocks enemies back
stun duration bonus only against full-life enemies (applies to all here)
skyfallLeap.loop: Leap Slam: leap to the target area, slamming and always knocking back enemies where you land; damaging hits always stun enemies on full life (20-39% increased stun duration against them); movement skill.

disposition.what: Always stuns an enemy on full life; knocks back.

slagBlow.loop: Molten Strike: melee hit (60% phys->fire) that launches molten balls from the struck enemy; they land around it and explode for AoE damage.

slagCarapace.loop: Molten Shell: guard skill (3 s, 4 s cooldown shared with guards, cooldown paused while active): adds armour, takes 75% of hit damage into a pool of 20% of armour (max 10000), then reflects 100-3000% of the absorbed damage as fire when it ends or is depleted.

slagLob.loop: Rolling Magma: lob an orb that explodes where it lands and chains 1-2 more times, bouncing on in the same direction and exploding again each time (spaced impacts).

slipstream.loop: Phase Run: instant buff for 1.8 s with 30-39% movement speed, phasing through enemies and 50% less visibility; using any skill replaces it with a 0.2 s melee-physical-damage buff (20-30% more); spends Frenzy charges to lengthen it; 4 s cooldown.

smokeCharge.loop: Smoke Mine: throw a mine that teleports you to it when detonated, leaving blinding smoke at both ends and a movement speed buff; shares the blink cooldown; 3 stored uses, 2.5 s cooldown.

snagLash.loop: Chain Hook: melee attack that, at range, hooks and pulls you to the enemy, hitting an area behind it; each hit gives 1 rage and the area grows by 1 per 5 rage.

snareShot.loop: Ensnaring Arrow: bow attack that snares what it hits (up to 3 snares, each 40% slower, less on rares/uniques) and makes ensnared enemies take 15-20% more damage from projectile attack hits.

sourHerald.loop: Herald of Agony: 20% poison chance and 10% more poison damage; poisoning grants Virulence (max 40, decaying faster the more you hold) and summons an Agony Crawler that grows stronger with Virulence and dies when it hits zero.

spearBurst.loop: Perforate: a ground-smash attack that is stance-dependent. In Blood Stance it raises six spikes in sequence in a small area that can hit an enemy several times (each 65% less damage); in Sand Stance the spikes thrust outward instead.

missing: does not pass through enemies or hit everything along the path: it stops short of the target and swings once at the end
no dive-through-a-pack clear; the movement is only a gap-closer
no recovery period or attack-time penalty (+0.6 s) for the dash
spinningDash.loop: Whirling Blades: a movement attack. The character dives in a straight line through enemies, hitting each one it passes once, then has a brief recovery; it is the delivery skill for Venom Gyre's caught projectiles.

disposition.what: Dashes through the target, hitting everything on the way.

spireTrap.loop: Lightning Spire Trap: a trap that, once an enemy triggers it, raises a spire that strikes random areas around it with lightning every ~0.5 s for a few seconds; faster casting means faster strikes; extra crit chance against shocked enemies.

spiritSaw.loop: Soulrend: a homing, always-piercing chaos spell projectile that leeches part of its damage as energy shield and repeatedly applies a short strong chaos damage-over-time debuff to every enemy near it as it flies.

spiritWardRite.loop: Spirit Offering: consume a corpse (and up to four more around it); for 5 s plus 1 s per extra corpse the minions gain energy shield (4% of life per corpse), a share of physical damage as chaos, and elemental resistances. One offering at a time.

splinterVolley.loop: Shattering Steel: an axe/sword attack that throws a fixed fan of steel projectiles that shatter on impact or after a short range into an area; they do more damage the farther they have travelled (up to 100% more), several can hit a close enemy (barrage-like), and it impales.

splitVolley.loop: Split Arrow: a bow attack that fires a fan of extra arrows (4 additional at level 1 to 8 at level 20), a single enemy being hit by at most one arrow of the volley.

standardOfDread.loop: Dread Banner: cast once to carry a banner (reserves mana) whose aura gives impale chance to you and allies and lessens enemy accuracy; gain stages by impaling while carrying it; cast again to put it down, where it is stronger/larger/longer per stage and grants a Fortify burst.

standardOfValour.loop: War Banner: carry a banner that raises accuracy for you and allies and makes nearby enemies take increased physical damage; gain stages by killing; cast again to put it down, scaled by stages with an Adrenaline burst.

staticCurse.loop: Conductivity: a curse on an area that lowers lightning resistance (-25 to -44%) and gives a chance for lightning damage to shock.

staticRing.loop: Shock Nova: a lightning nova around you with an initial ring (50% less damage) followed by a larger full circle; a 20% shock chance with strongly increased shock effect.

missing: no taunt
charges do not scale with number of nearby enemies (always one)
steadfastBellow.loop: Enduring Cry: a warcry that grants endurance charges (scaled by nearby enemies, minimum one), a short burst of life regeneration, and taunts nearby enemies; shares a cooldown with other warcries.

missing: the life regeneration is permanent rather than only while the golem is alive
no taunting slam or rolling charge
stoneColossus.loop: Summon Stone Golem: one golem (the largest life pool) that fights beside you and grants you life regeneration while it lives; it also has a taunting slam and a rolling charge.

stoneStance.loop: Flesh and Stone: an aura tied to the Blood/Sand stance: in Blood nearby enemies are maimed and take increased physical damage; in Sand nearby enemies are blinded and you take less damage from attacks by enemies that are not nearby. The stance is shared with Blood and Sand and alternates.

stormArrow.loop: Lightning Arrow: a bow attack, half converted to lightning, whose arrow causes a lightning bolt that also hits up to 3 additional enemies near the target; strong shock effect and it shocks as though dealing 100-195% more damage.

missing: mine aura: enemies near the mines take increased damage (3% per mine, up to 150%)
5 s mine duration (uses the generic mine lifetime)
stormCharge.loop: Stormblast Mine: a remote mine (5 s, detonation 0.25 s) that deals lightning damage in an area with shock; each mine also carries an aura that makes enemies near it take 3% increased damage, up to 150%.

disposition.what: Enemies near its mines take 3% more damage from each, up to 150%.

missing: owner speed bonus is always on, not tied to the golem standing
no lightning orbs or added-damage aura
stormColossus.loop: Summon Lightning Golem: one golem that grants you increased attack and cast speed while it lives; it fires a lightning projectile spell, makes lightning orbs and a temporary aura giving its allies added lightning damage.

stormHalo.loop: Wrath: an aura that adds lightning damage to attacks and makes spells deal more lightning damage.

stormHerald.loop: Herald of Thunder: added lightning damage to spells and attacks; killing a shocked enemy makes lightning bolts strike enemies around you for a short time.

stormQuill.loop: Galvanic Arrow: a bow attack releasing short-lived arrows (half lightning) together with a burst of lightning that damages all enemies in a cone in front.

stormRush.loop: Charged Dash: channel to send an illusion ahead that you steer, gaining stages as it moves, waves of area damage pulsing along its path; release to teleport to the illusion with a final wave scaled by stages.

stormWard.loop: Purity of Lightning: an aura giving lightning resistance (22-41%) and, at higher levels, extra maximum lightning resistance.

suddenFrost.loop: Cold Snap: a burst of cold at a target place that also leaves expanding chilled ground dealing cold damage over time; enemies dying in it can grant Frenzy charges; the cooldown can be bypassed by spending a Frenzy charge.

sweepingCut.loop: Reave: a frontal area attack; each use that hits grants a stage (50% more area each) which decays after a short time without hitting.

tempestMote.loop: Orb of Storms: a stationary lightning orb for 6 s that periodically zaps a nearby enemy with a bolt that splits to others; faster casting speeds it; casting a lightning skill inside it makes it strike again; a new orb replaces the old.

tempestSigil.loop: Storm Brand: a brand that attaches to an enemy and every 0.6 s fires beams that hit the attached target and chain to nearby enemies, detaching if the enemy dies.

thunderRebuke.loop: Smite: a melee strike (half lightning) that also calls lightning down in an area (the struck enemy not hit twice) and gives you an aura for 4 s adding lightning damage and shock chance.

tideOfJudgement.loop: Wave of Conviction: a physical spell wave (a quarter fire, a quarter lightning) that expands in a cone; each enemy hit is exposed to the element it took most damage from; one wave at a time.

tinderCurse.loop: Flammability: a curse on an area lowering fire resistance (-25 to -44%) and giving a chance for fire damage to ignite.

torchArrow.loop: Burning Arrow: a fully fire-converted bow attack with 50% ignite chance and more ignite damage; an ignite also applies a stacking (to 5) burning debuff worth a share of the ignite's damage.

toxinCircle.loop: Venom Gyre: a poisonous chaos projectile that returns to you (75% less damage on the way back) and can be caught (up to 30); Whirling Blades then releases all caught projectiles in a spiral.

twinBlades.loop: Dual Strike: dual wield only; strikes with both weapons in one hit, with extra crit chance, and against enemies on full life more crit chance and damage.

twinCut.loop: Double Strike: two fast melee strikes in one use (25% bleed chance), with added physical damage against bleeding enemies.

missing: bleed chance and more bleed damage should only apply in Blood Stance
Sand Stance wider angle (+50%) absent
no stance trade-off at all, unlike Spear Burst and Whirlwind Cleave
twinSlash.loop: Lacerate: two overlapping slashes. It is a stance skill: in Blood Stance it has 25% bleed chance and 50-88% more damage with bleeding; in Sand Stance the slashes are 50% wider. The player chooses a stance for bleed or area.

disposition.what: Bleeds only in Blood Stance; a wider sweep in Sand Stance.

twisterBlade.loop: Cyclone: channel to spin and move toward a target, hitting enemies around you, building stages that widen the spin; you cannot be stunned while channelling; the first hit is weaker.

veilOfGrace.loop: Grace: an aura granting flat evasion rating to you and allies.

missing: 50% physical-to-chaos conversion and added chaos damage (so chaos modifiers and Despair do not help it)
dual-wield: hitting with both weapons
poison duration tied to skill duration
venomCut.loop: Viper Strike: a dagger/claw/sword strike that converts 50% of physical to chaos, adds chaos damage, has a 60% poison chance whose duration is the skill's own, and strikes with both weapons when dual wielding.

disposition.what: Converts 50% to chaos, adds chaos damage, 60% poison for four seconds, both weapons when dual wielding.

venomShower.loop: Toxic Rain: arrows fired into the air land around the target and leave spore pods that deal chaos damage over time and slow nearby enemies, then burst for area damage.

venomStrike.loop: Pestilent Strike: a claw/dagger strike (half chaos, 60% poison, 30% more poison duration) that debuffs the target; if it dies poisoned, enemies around it take a chaos damage-over-time debuff of 50% of its remaining poison damage per second.

viperLash.loop: Cobra Lash: a dagger/claw attack firing a poisonous chaos projectile that chains between enemies (3 to 5 chains).

vitalHalo.loop: Vitality: an aura granting percentage life regeneration.

voidCurse.loop: Despair: a curse lowering chaos resistance, increasing damage over time taken, and making cursed enemies take additional chaos damage when hit.

wakeBlades.loop: Animate Weapon: animate a weapon found on the ground to fight at your side for a limited time, limited by item level; it uses the weapon's damage plus the gem's added damage.

wakeSentinel.loop: Animate Guardian: animate weapons and armour from the ground onto a single Guardian that fights beside you; multiple items attach to the same Guardian.

warchiefTotem.loop: Ancestral Warchief: summons a totem that slams enemies with a powerful attack while you are near it; being near it grants you more melee damage.

warden.loop: Purity of Elements: an aura granting resistance to all elements.

warlordSigil.loop: Warlord's Mark: a mark on enemies in an area: more likely to be stunned and slower to recover, your attacks leech life and mana from them, and killing them can grant an Endurance charge.

whirlShot.loop: Tornado Shot: a piercing shot that travels to the target location then releases three secondary projectiles in all directions that fade.

whirlwindCleave.loop: Bladestorm: a spinning attack that leaves a bladestorm matching your stance: Blood storms are stationary and speed attacks while you stand in them; Sand storms drift forward and speed movement. Three storms at most.

whirringMotes.loop: Summon Skitterbots: a chilling and a shocking bot that follow you with auras, trigger your traps and detonate your mines (which re-arm), and grant more trap and mine damage; they reserve mana.

witheringBreath.loop: Blight: a channelled chaos damage-over-time debuff on enemies in front, each continued channel adding a layer (up to 20) with its own duration; enemies not already affected are briefly hindered.

arrowTempest.loop: Arrow Nova (3.9 wiki): a forward-firing bow skill instead fires its payload arrow at the ground; where it lands, secondary projectiles fly out in a nova carrying the skill's effects, for less projectile damage.

ashbreaker.loop: Fire Penetration: the skill's fire damage from hits ignores a share of the target's fire resistance (penetration does not touch damage over time).

bloodRefund.loop: Life Gain on Hit: flat life gained instantly for every enemy hit by the supported attack (each pierced enemy counts), stacking with other life on hit.

missing: supports only attack skills; the 3.9 gem supports any skill that hits, so spell builds cannot take life leech from the gem
flat 2 percent at all levels (number only; not counted)
bloodthirst.loop: Life Leech: any skill that hits leeches a share of the damage dealt as life over time (works with any damage type, not with damage over time). A skill-level sustain support for attackers and casters alike.

disposition.what: Supports any skill that hits.

bluntIntent.loop: Brutality: a large more multiplier to physical damage, paid for by dealing no elemental or chaos damage at all (including converted or added damage and the ailments built from it).

briefBurst.loop: Less Duration: shortens every effect the supported skill produces (ground, clouds, buffs, totems and so on) in exchange for more damage; best on skills whose effect lands a moment after use.

missing: the 3.9 more damage with bleeding and poison from melee hits (second stat of the gem) is not implemented; a bleed build gets only the hit bonus
values are 40-59 against 30-49 in the original (number only; not counted)
bruteForce.loop: Melee Physical Damage: more physical damage for melee attacks, and (in 3.9) the same percentage more damage with poison and bleeding caused by melee hits, which is why bleed builds take it.

disposition.why: The extra poison and bleed damage from melee hits is missing (ailments take no melee tag, a 3.9 rule).

bulwarkStrikes.loop: Fortify: melee hits give you the Fortify buff (20 percent less damage from hits for a few seconds) and the supported melee skill deals more damage; a defensive-offensive melee support.

burningPack.loop: Infernal Legion: summoned minions are wreathed in fire that deals non-stacking fire damage over time to nearby enemies while they burn themselves (a share of their life per second).

chainedCharges.loop: Blastchain Mine: the skill is thrown as mines (short-lived) that all detonate in a quick chain once triggered, each mine dealing more damage for each earlier detonation, at less damage overall.

channelledElements.loop: Elemental Focus: a big more multiplier to elemental damage, at the cost of the skill (and its other supports) being unable to inflict elemental ailments.

chargedBreath.loop: Infused Channelling: channelled skill deals more damage, you take less damage from hits of the skill's damage types while channelling, and after channelling a while you gain Infusion (more damage) that lingers after you stop.

missing: restricted to spells; 3.9 Immolate supports any skill that hits enemies, so attack ignite builds cannot use it
cindering.loop: Immolate: any skill that hits adds flat fire damage against burning (ignited) enemies, making ignite-and-exploit builds hit harder once the target burns.

disposition.what: Supports any skill that hits.

closeQuarters.loop: Point Blank: the supported projectile skill is treated as having the Point Blank keystone: up to 30 percent more projectile attack damage when the target is near, falling to 50 percent at the end of range; plus projectile damage.

criticalRelay.loop: Cast on Critical Strike: linked spells are triggered (no mana, no cast time, 0.15 s cooldown each, rotating among multiple spells) whenever an attack skill crits.

cruelFlight.loop: Vicious Projectiles: projectile attacks deal more physical damage and more physical and chaos damage over time (bleed and poison), but attack a little slower.

crueltyEdge.loop: Increased Critical Damage: adds to the critical strike multiplier of the supported skill (works for minions, traps, totems too).

dazzle.loop: Blind: hits have a chance to blind the enemy, greatly reducing its chance to hit with attacks for a short duration (duration scalable); blind is a debuff separate from curses.

deepChill.loop: Bonechill: bigger chill effect, and enemies chilled by the supported skill take more cold damage, rewarding chill-then-hit cold builds.

deepInsight.loop: Enlighten: no modifiers; its sole function is a mana multiplier below 100 percent that lowers the cost (and reservation) of the supported gem and its supports, letting a link carry more supports.

deepWinter.loop: Hypothermia: more damage with hits against chilled enemies, more cold damage over time, stronger chill and a chance to freeze already-chilled enemies.

denseBlast.loop: Concentrated Effect: more area damage, less area of effect (the radius shrinks only about 16 percent for 30 percent less area).

doubleRelease.loop: Unleash: while the spell is not cast it builds Seals (up to a cap); the next cast spends all Seals as extra rapid repeats of the spell, each at less damage.

doubleSet.loop: Swift Assembly: a trap or mine skill has a chance to throw 1, 2 or 3 additional traps or mines per throw (in a small circle).

echoingBlow.loop: Ancestral Call: a melee single-target strike also strikes two other nearby enemies at the same time, with one shared critical roll.

echoingCast.loop: Spell Echo: the spell is cast a second time right after the first (one cost, rolls once), for a cast speed bonus and slightly less damage; not for totems, traps, mines or triggered spells.

elementalEdge.loop: Elemental Damage with Attacks: more elemental damage for the supported attack, including ignites and secondary damage.

elementalPack.loop: Elemental Army: minions gain elemental resistances and a higher maximum, deal more elemental damage, and their hits apply exposure of the element they dealt.

emberInfusion.loop: Added Fire Damage: a percentage of physical damage is also dealt as fire (follows conversion rules), converting a physical build's damage into extra fire damage.

exaltedFocus.loop: Empower: raises the level of the supported active skill gem (nothing at level 1), improving its numbers.

fannedFlame.loop: Burning Damage: more burning (ignite) damage for the supported skill, including skills that burn directly.

missing: no chance to poison on hit and no more poison damage, which is all the resolved 3.9 text describes
if instead the original is a crit-ailment gem: the bonus keys off a previous crit rather than the crit that applied the ailment
festeringCrit.loop: Critical Strike Affliction Support (no PoB data). The only 3.9 text the project tool resolves for this page is the Poison Support page (same dex, level 31): 60 percent chance to Poison on hit and more damage with poison. If the true gem is a crit-ailment gem the verdict would be drifted.

disposition.why: Not a 3.9 gem: as of 3.9 the page is Poison Support, which Toxin Coat already stands for.

fieldOfCharges.loop: Minefield: throws up to four additional mines at once and allows more mines out simultaneously, at a heavy mine throwing speed penalty.

firmHold.loop: Iron Grip: strength's physical damage bonus (normally melee only) also applies to the physical damage of the supported projectile attack.

flankingCast.loop: Spell Cascade: an area spell also lands in front of and behind the targeted spot, at less area and less damage; not for totems, traps or mines.

focusedRuin.loop: Controlled Destruction: much more spell damage but the spell cannot critically strike.

foulBrew.loop: Vile Toxins: more poison damage, and hits deal more damage for each poison stack on the target (capped).

freedRot.loop: Unbound Ailments: ailments last longer, damaging ailments deal more damage, and non-damaging ailments (shock, chill) have a greater effect.

frenziedPack.loop: Feeding Frenzy: supported minions are aggressive, and each hit has a chance to grant you a timed buff that makes all your minions faster and harder-hitting.

freshVigour.loop: Damage on Full Life: more damage with the supported attack while the player is on full life.

frostFang.loop: Ice Bite: chance to freeze, added cold damage that rises with frenzy charges, and a chance to gain a frenzy charge when you kill a frozen enemy; not for totems, traps or mines.

frostbreaker.loop: Supported hits penetrate (18-37)% of the enemy's cold resistance, so cold builds get past resistant monsters.

missing: added physical damage with weapons at >=10 rage and per 10 rage (the support's own damage payload)
0.4 s cooldown on rage gain per hit (area hits stack rage)
rage bonuses are Bob's generic ones, not this gem's scaling
fury.loop: Melee hits grant 1 Rage (no more than once per 0.4 s); the support's own payload is added physical damage with weapons while at 10+ Rage and per 10 Rage, so the rage you build feeds the attack.

disposition.what: Rage once in 0.4 s; added physical damage with rage.

galvanise.loop: 50% of the supported skill's physical damage is converted to lightning, and a further (10-29)% of physical is gained as extra lightning.

glimpseOfCrit.loop: Supported skills have (35-54)% chance to gain a Power Charge on critical strike, and deal 4% more damage per Power Charge.

missing: reduced enemy dodge (no enemy dodge in Bob anyway)
guardBreaker.loop: Enemies have less chance to block attacks/spells from supported skills (and dodge), and a blocked hit inflicts Overpowered for 4 s, a stacking -5% block. A PvP-leaning recipe gem.

hamstring.loop: Supported attacks have 30% chance to maim; maimed enemies take (10-14)% increased physical damage (and move slower); the skill deals (15-30)% more physical damage.

hardyPack.loop: Minions from the supported skill have (30-49)% more maximum life.

missing: reduced duration of the skill's own effect (only ailment duration is cut)
hastenedRot.loop: (25-44)% more damage over time, but 15% reduced duration of the skill and its damaging ailments, so they burn faster and end sooner.

heavyCharge.loop: The skill is laid as a remote mine (5 s) whose aura gives hits against nearby enemies a 2% chance to deal double damage (stacking per mine); the supported skill deals less damage; cannot be melee.

missing: reduced curse duration trade
hexes land on hits of any skill, not only the supported one
hexingStrikes.loop: Hextouch: the supported skill applies the curses linked to it when it hits instead of the player casting them, at reduced curse duration.

keenEye.loop: Adds (74-1034) flat accuracy rating to the supported attack.

missing: cannot support spells (original supports any skill that hits)
kindle.loop: Supported skills deal (42-205) to (63-308) added fire damage against burning enemies, rewarding an ignite source.

disposition.what: Supports any skill that hits.

kindledFrost.loop: 50% of cold damage is converted to fire, plus (10-29)% of cold gained as extra fire.

knifeRange.loop: Close Combat: up to (40-59)% more melee damage to enemies based on proximity; hits grant Combat Rush (2 s) that speeds the next unsupported movement skill; axes and swords only.

lightheart.loop: Inspiration: (25-34)% reduced mana cost; each mana spend by the supported skill gives an Inspiration charge (more elemental damage and crit chance per charge); all charges are lost once a mana total is spent.

lingeringCruelty.loop: (45-64)% more damage with ailments, 10% less damage with hits.

missing: no effect on utility buffs, guards, warcries, offerings
no effect on curse/hex duration
lingeringEffect.loop: (45-64)% increased skill effect duration with no downside: totems, minions, ground effects, buffs and curses last longer.

disposition.what: Curses, buffs, guards and warcries last longer too.

lingeringShots.loop: Projectiles are (30-49)% slower and the skill deals (20-29)% more projectile damage.

missing: Innervation buff on killing a shocked enemy (the gem's signature loop)
livewire.loop: Innervate: adds lightning damage and 20% shock chance; killing a shocked enemy with the supported skill grants Innervation for 8 s, adding lightning damage to all your hits.

disposition.what: Killing a shocked enemy gives Innervation.

livewireCharges.loop: Mines from supported skills may grant Frenzy and Power charges when detonated; frenzy speeds mine throwing, power raises mine crit chance.

livewireSnares.loop: Traps may grant Power and Frenzy charges when triggered; frenzy speeds trap throwing, power adds crit multiplier for the trap.

mercilessCadence.loop: Every third use of the melee attack is a Ruthless Blow: (75-132)% more melee damage, a stun, and (75-132)% more bleed damage.

mercyStroke.loop: Enemies left at 10% life or less after being hit by the supported skill are killed; up to 38% increased damage at high levels.

packFury.loop: Minions from the supported skill deal (25-49)% more damage.

packHaste.loop: Minions have (25-44)% increased movement speed and (25-34)% attack and cast speed.

missing: increased skill effect duration
patientPower.loop: Efficacy: (10-20)% more spell damage, (15-24)% more damage over time, (10-16)% increased skill effect duration.

piercingShot.loop: Projectiles pierce (2-4) additional targets, and deal up to 19% more projectile damage at high levels.

precisionStrikes.loop: Supported skills have (50-88)% increased crit chance and +(1-1.9)% to base crit chance.

quickCast.loop: Supported spells have (20-39)% increased cast speed.

missing: trigger on actual stun
single heavy hit vs accumulated damage
reelingCast.loop: Cast when Stunned: supported spells are cast when the player is stunned (cooldown 0.25 s), so a heavy hit becomes an automatic defensive cast.

disposition.what: Triggers when the character is stunned.

missing: gem quality does not exist; stand-in only
refineGem.loop: Enhance: raises the quality of supported gems.

rendingEdge.loop: Chance to Bleed: 25% chance to bleed, more bleed damage, and added physical damage with weapons; attacks only.

rendingThirst.loop: Bloodlust: more melee physical damage against bleeding enemies, but supported skills cannot inflict bleeding at all.

ricochet.loop: Chain: projectiles chain 2 additional times (damage less); also supports other chaining skills.

rimeSeed.loop: Adds cold damage to hits of the supported skill, scaling with gem level.

rollingVolleys.loop: Barrage: 3 additional projectiles fired in rapid sequence so all can hit one enemy, each far weaker, and the attack takes longer.

rout.loop: Hits have (25-44)% chance to make enemies flee.

scavenger.loop: (40-59)% increased rarity of items dropped by enemies killed by the supported skill; a utility slot traded for loot.

setSnare.loop: Trap: instead of using the skill, the character throws a trap that uses it when an enemy walks near (short duration); trap throwing speed and damage grow with level; no channelling.

shatteringBlows.loop: Shockwave: melee hits with maces/staves trigger an area shockwave around the target dealing a share of base attack damage.

siphonDraught.loop: Supported attacks leech (2-3.9)% of damage dealt as mana.

missing: no impaleEffect (the +20-49% increased impale effect): skill.ts:737 reads db.inc('impaleEffect') but Skewer provides none, so the port note's 'stronger impale' is not true
no -30% physical damage reduction against impale hits
skewer.loop: Impale Support: attacks get 40% chance to impale on hit (the debuff records 10% of the hit's physical damage and pays it back, as reflected physical, on the target's next 5 hits), plus increased impale effect, more physical damage, and a penalty to the target's physical damage reduction against impale hits. A damage-per-hit-taken scaling for physical attack builds.

missing: any melee kill by the character triggers it; there is no requirement that a melee attack gem be linked to it (the original needs both a melee attack and a spell linked)
slayersEcho.loop: Cast on Melee Kill: a linked melee attack that kills triggers the linked spell(s) (0.15 s cooldown, no mana cost, spell becomes triggered-only). Gives a melee character a spell proc off kills; not usable on totems, traps, mines.

slowRot.loop: Decay Support: hits inflict Decay, a flat chaos damage per second for 8 seconds that does not depend on the hit's damage (but scales with chaos/DoT modifiers). A hit-independent DoT that makes weak hitters or multi-hit skills add chaos pressure.

missing: ring placement is shared with Triple Snare; the original differs only in layout (random circle vs line), which is cosmetic
snareCluster.loop: Cluster Traps: a trap throw puts down 2 additional traps scattered around the target point (up to 5 additional traps standing), each throw dealing 55-36% less damage. Trades per-trap damage for a burst of simultaneous traps.

sparkSeed.loop: Added Lightning Damage: adds a wide spread of lightning damage (about 10% to 190% of the base value) to the hits of the supported skill; a flat-added source that favours fast, low-base hitters and lets a skill gain lightning.

splitShot.loop: Fork: projectiles fork into two the first time they hit an enemy and do not pierce it; small projectile damage change (-10% to +9% more). Coverage of packs and the fork-and-chain style.

staggerResolve.loop: Endurance Charge on Melee Stun: stunning an enemy with a supported melee hit grants an Endurance Charge; the skill deals 4% more damage per Endurance Charge; enemies are easier to stun (0-19% reduced threshold). A stun-to-defence-and-damage loop.

missing: level scaling is on stun duration (the original's quality-only effect) while the threshold reduction is a flat 20 rather than 30-49
restricted to attack skills; the original supports any skill that hits
staggeringForce.loop: Stun Support: the supported skill's hits have 30-49% reduced enemy stun threshold, so stuns happen much more easily; any hitting skill.

missing: not limited to bows and wands (any non-melee attack)
standingBow.loop: Ballista Totem: a bow or wand attack is used by a ballista totem you place instead of by you (up to 3 ballistas, each at 50% less attack speed and weaker); melee uses are excluded. Converts a ranged attack into stationary, multiple, slower shooters while you move.

standingCast.loop: Spell Totem: a non-triggered spell is cast by a totem you summon instead of by you (30% less cast speed, 35-26% less damage, lasts 8 s). You act while the totem casts.

standingCurse.loop: Blasphemy: the supported curse is not cast but becomes an aura around you that curses every enemy in its radius, reserving 35% of maximum mana (reduced by reservation efficiency), with increased curse area at higher levels; counts against the curse limit.

steelResolve.loop: Iron Will: the supported spell gets Strength's damage bonus (1% increased per 5 Strength) applied to all of its spell damage, plus up to 38% increased spell damage; lets a strength-stacker use spells.

stormbreaker.loop: Lightning Penetration: hits penetrate 18-37% of enemy lightning resistance; the damage multiplier for lightning builds that face resistant enemies.

missing: teleport does not clear Intensity at once
swellingBlast.loop: Intensify: a self-cast area spell gains an Intensity each cast (up to 4): each gives 10-16% more area damage and 12% less area; the spell has 35-54% increased area; Intensity is lost every 0.25 s while moving. Rewards standing and casting; excludes totems, traps, mines, channelling, triggered.

swiftAssault.loop: Faster Attacks: 25-44% increased attack speed for the supported attack.

swiftFlight.loop: Faster Projectiles: 50-69% increased projectile speed and 20-29% increased projectile damage.

missing: cooldownRecovery has no effect (support mod never reaches the cooldown code); traps with a cooldown and stored uses (Jaws Trap cooldown 4 s, 3 uses) are not helped
only the throwing-speed and effect-duration parts of the gem work
swiftSnares.loop: Advanced Traps: the supported trap is thrown 15-34% faster, has 50-107% increased cooldown recovery for throwing traps (so traps with a cooldown like Bear Trap come back sooner), and 10-29% increased skill effect duration.

disposition.what: The cooldown recovery of the support reaches the skill.

missing: the mana-spent threshold is gone: buff on every cast instead of after spending a total of mana
buff strength does not scale with gem level (fixed 10/10/0.5)
no extra spell damage on the supported skill while Arcane Surge is up
mana spent is not tracked, so the mana-cost / uptime trade-off disappears
tideGathering.loop: Arcane Surge: the supported spell tracks the mana you spend on it; when the total reaches a threshold (15 mana at level 1 up to 400 at level 20) you gain Arcane Surge for 4 s (more spell damage, increased cast speed, mana regeneration scaling with gem level), and the spell also deals more damage while you have it. A spend-mana-to-earn-buff loop with an uptime that depends on your mana spent.

disposition.what: Arcane Surge after the supported skills have spent enough mana; more spell damage while it lasts.

tinderbox.loop: Combustion: 30-49% chance to ignite, 10-29% more fire damage, and enemies ignited by the skill have -10 to -19% fire resistance. A fire-ignite amplifier whose resistance shred benefits other fire sources.

missing: one totem is placed per cast instead of the original's summon of several in a single cast
totemChoir.loop: Multiple Totems: a totem skill summons 2 additional totems (3 stand at once), each doing 40-21% less damage; many weaker totems for area/DPS coverage.

missing: no added chaos damage to the hit; replaced by a more-poison-damage bonus
toxinCoat.loop: Chance to Poison: 40% chance to poison on hit and added chaos damage (level 1-2 up to 94-141) that feeds the poison; the base entry gem for poison builds.

tripleCadence.loop: Multistrike: a melee attack repeats twice (three strikes per use), each repeat targeting a random enemy in range, the repeats dealing 22% and 44% more damage, with 35-44% more melee attack speed and 20-10% less attack damage; not channelling.

missing: flat -18% damage and +10% speed instead of the 15 to 6% penalty with no speed bonus (numbers only)
tripleShot.loop: Lesser Multiple Projectiles: +2 projectiles, with 15-6% less projectile damage; spreading more projectiles for clearing/shotgun.

missing: line layout replaced by ring layout (cosmetic)
tripleSnare.loop: Multiple Traps: a throw puts down 2 additional traps in a line (up to 3 more standing), each throw dealing 50-31% less damage.

twinSalvo.loop: Volley: 2 additional projectiles fired in parallel from the user, with 12-3% less projectile damage; a wider front instead of a cone.

twinShadow.loop: Mirage Archer: bow attack hits summon a Mirage Archer (one at a time, 4 s) that uses the same skill with 31-40% less damage and 60% less attack speed; restricts the skill to bows.

missing: no increased Elusive effect (0-28%)
veilCut.loop: Nightblade: the supported attack grants Elusive on critical strike; while Elusive the skill has +0.7-1% crit chance and +80-99% crit multiplier; increased Elusive effect at higher levels; restricted to daggers and claws.

venomSeed.loop: Added Chaos Damage: adds a tight range of chaos damage (about 80-120% of the base) to the supported skill's hits, scaling strongly with gem level; a flat chaos source that also feeds poison.

voidTwist.loop: Void Manipulation: 20-39% more chaos damage and 25% reduced elemental damage; converts a skill's output toward chaos at an elemental penalty.

missing: +4 projectiles became +2, so the Greater tier is indistinguishable from Lesser Multiple Projectiles (tripleShot)
combined 6 extra projectiles with the lesser gem is not possible
volleySplit.loop: Greater Multiple Projectiles: +4 additional projectiles with 35-26% less projectile damage (stacks with Lesser MP for +6); the heavy-spread, high-penalty tier above LMP.

disposition.what: Four additional projectiles at 35% to 26% less damage.

wardSiphon.loop: Energy Leech: 1.5-1.9% of damage leeched as energy shield; the skill deals 12-24% more damage while on full energy shield and 20-39% more while leeching energy shield.

missing: no taunt on hit (enemies do not pick minions here, so the less-damage-taken part also matters little)
wardingPack.loop: Meat Shield: the minions from the supported skill are Defensive (stay close to you and go for enemies near you), take 15-24% less damage, deal 20-30% more damage to enemies near you, move 10-29% faster, and have 20% chance to taunt on hit.

wideBlast.loop: Increased Area of Effect: 30-49% increased area of effect for area skills.

wideCrush.loop: Pulverise: melee attacks get 40-59% more area damage, 25-34% increased area of effect, and 15% less attack speed; trades speed for a bigger, heavier area hit.

wideSalvo.loop: Greater Volley: 4 additional projectiles fired in parallel from the user, with 30-21% less projectile damage.

wildfireSeed.loop: Ignite Proliferation: ignites caused by the skill spread to other enemies within a radius (14-20, keeps spreading while the carrier burns and as it dies) and deal 20-39% more ignite damage.

wildfireSpread.loop: Elemental Proliferation: elemental ailments (ignite, shock, chill, freeze) caused by the skill spread to enemies within a radius (12-15), including through death; 20% chance to freeze, shock and ignite; up to 19% increased elemental ailment duration.

wiredHarm.loop: Trap and Mine Damage: 30-49% more damage for traps and mines, thrown/laid 10% slower.

witherMark.loop: Withering Touch: attacks gain 10-29% of physical damage as extra chaos damage and have 25% chance to inflict Withered on hit (each stack +6% chaos damage taken, up to 15 stacks, 2 s).

missing: threshold is a fixed share of maximum life instead of the original's level-scaled absolute damage; no damage penalty or level cap on the supported spell
woundedRetort.loop: Cast when Damage Taken: the linked spell(s) are triggered when you have taken a total of a set amount of damage from hits (counter resets on trigger); 0.25 s cooldown; no direct casting of the spell; triggered spells cost no mana.
